producer_report.summary: Athena's "fails without the fix" demonstration runs are now stored as checks in the verification record, and a behavior criterion that cites such a run's command or its record name counts as seen running (D43). Previously the run was shown to the verifier but not recorded, so judge() ignored it, which is what rejected job 20261104-081830-js1p. Changes: CheckRun gets `revert_for: Vec<u32>` (the criterion numbers the run is for, skipped when empty, so old records still load). New `demonstration_name` and `revert_record` helpers in verify.rs make the shown, run and stored names agree. run/checks.rs returns each run's view together with its record, and run/verification.rs appends the records after the verifier's input is built. judge() skips revert records in the job-wide list and counts their command or name only for the criteria in `revert_for`, only on the candidate's tree, and only if the run finished; `passed` is always true so they never block a verdict. Carried check lines render `name: revert run (exit code N)`, and the PR body's 'N checks passed' ignores revert runs. Tests cover the judge rule, record shape, round-trip and old-shape loading, the run-level path, and the carried line. CHANGELOG.md and docs/design/job-planning.md state the scope in prose. The full cargo test --locked, clippy and fmt all passed.

open_issues: Departure from the reading: the marker is `revert_for: Vec<u32>` (criteria numbers) rather than `revert: bool`, and `passed` is always true for revert records rather than meaning 'failed as expected'. Both follow the accepted plan and are documented in the field doc, changelog and design doc.

crates/athena-core/src/run/close.rs is not a listed deliverable but was edited (measured_check_count and a test) so the pull-request body's 'N checks passed' does not count revert runs. The user question in the plan about accepting this is unanswered.

Within one criterion the code cannot tell the 'fails without' half from the 'passes with' half, so a criterion in the group that cites the revert command for its other half also counts as seen. Closing that needs a fails_without field on the reading's Criterion record, which is out of scope.
check_minutes in status.rs now includes the revert run's duration, as the plan accepted.
mistakes: First pass missed the CheckRun literal in the records.rs tests; the compiler flagged it and it is fixed.
learnings: Replacing the text `reused: false,` in each file with the same line plus `revert_for: Vec::new(),` then running cargo fmt --all fixed nearly every CheckRun literal; the compiler found the rest (verify.rs and records.rs tests).
cargo build --tests reported only the athena-core error first; the athena-data test literal in records.rs surfaced only when that crate's tests were built.
gh/tests.rs has no CheckRun literal; it only names the type, so it needed no edit.

The admission test ci_reuse_replay_the_seen_commands_filter_turns_up_in_a_search_and_must_be_named searches verify.rs for the job-wide filter text, so the revert rule had to be a separate block and a `continue`, not an edit of that filter.
Bash here allows only cargo, git, chmod, ls, mv, rm: no grep, tail, sed; and Read cannot open files under /tmp, so a background command's output file is unreadable.
desires: One shared test constructor for CheckRun instead of about 20 literals.
